scope: Negative control for (a): the reentry fail-stop replaced by Busy; the probe must time out. The fail-stop code is unchanged between cf032d4 and fa4b588.

gates.command: NEG=1: sed SharedFaultResult::Reentry(which) -> SharedFaultResult::Busy in kernel/kernel_core/fork.rs; make build; python3 scripts/gates/qemu/shared_fault_reentry_probe.py --cases mm --timeout 300

limitations: TCG (no KVM) on a shared 40-core dev host
logs stay on the dev host; only their SHA-256 is recorded here
